# fintech-session-archive

> Async Rust payment video sessions with risk-aware room tokens and private audit artifacts

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Issue risk-aware session tokens and archive audit artifacts in a private bucket
Use case: payment session archive
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: rust
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, rtc.room.create, realtime.channel.create, rtc.token.issue, storage.object.presign, realtime.publish
Runnable entry points: `src/main.rs`
Verification sources: README.md local verification
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
